body: Quick pass (author side, not a review): merges cleanly with main at 91df505a; the body has what changed, the pinning tests, Not exercised, Changelog and Fixes #1199; #1199 is P1 (not paused). Flagged ready for NeoTech's independent review. Behaviour note for the reviewer: a user's own mill script with no `capabilities` line, posting a milling op on a lathe or mill-turn setup, is now refused, and the message names the one-line fix. (M5)
Back to draft to push a merge of main: it conflicted with #1174 in `post/dialect.rs`, and both sides read the `capabilities` mask.

Merged main at 17f6ce33. The conflict was real: main's #1174 added `post::dialect::WorkVoice` / `work_voice()` and said "#1199 settles undeclared scripts for good". This PR had added its own `declared_turning()`.

**Resolution.** Took main's `dialect.rs` as it stands and dropped `declared_turning`. `lathe_voice::at_post` now matches on `WorkVoice`:
- `ToolSpindle` passes.
- `WorkSpindle` is held to the door.
- `Undeclared` is held on a lathe or mill-turn, with the refusal naming the missing `capabilities` line. It passes elsewhere.

**Behaviour change from the earlier head:** masks 0 and 4 are now Undeclared, as main reads them, so they are held on a work-spindle machine rather than passed as a mill post. That's the stricter reading. The pin covers 0 and 4 explicitly, and the decision file is updated.

**Main's matrix test** `lathe_workholding_mill_post::every_machine_dialect_and_section_cell_gives_its_verdict`: for an undeclared script, a milling (tool) section on a chucked machine is now refused by the lathe door first, by name, exactly as for a declared turning post, so it no longer reaches the chuck-rpm judgement. Its expected verdict is updated (`!chucked`). The program is still refused.

**Gate on the merged head** (debug, this Mac):
- Unit tests: lathe_voice 4 and post dialect 3.
- App suites: posting 17, lathe_post_refusals 11, lathe_work_spindle 5, lathe_workholding_mill_post 3, lathe_workholding_live 3, lathe_workholding_kinds 10 (1 ignored), per_op_files 9, setup_mounts_post 6, conformance 6.
- `clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app --lib --tests -D warnings` is clean.

Author-side note, not a review. Ready again for NeoTech's review. (M5)
Back to draft to push the fix for the review of 17f6ce33 (an undeclared script on a lathe or mill-turn now posts only C sections). Will flag ready again once pushed, gated and the body updated.

Answer to the review of `17f6ce33`. New head: `27dee0df` (one commit; upstream main not merged in, since it merges cleanly).

**Blocker: a turning section through an undeclared script on a lathe or mill-turn.** Fixed in `crates/app/src/lathe_voice.rs` `at_post`. On a setup whose machine has a work spindle, the `Undeclared` arm now refuses every section except a C-axis live-tool section (`voice_of` == `LiveTool`).
- Milling sections are refused with the lathe door's own reason, as before.
- Turning kinds and on-centre drills are now refused too. The refusal says "a <kind> operation turns the work, and only a turning post may post it - an unstated script is not known to be one, and through a milling post it would come out as milling (a tool change, S M3 on the tool spindle, the work standing still)".
- Both refusals keep the manifest wording: no `capabilities` line naming 1 or 2, the setup's machine, `capabilities = 2;` for a turning post, `capabilities = 1;` for a milling post.
- An op with no path is still left to the program gate.
- Mill and no-machine are unchanged.

So #1213 and #1265 now agree: an undeclared script posts on a mill or with no machine, and on a lathe or mill-turn it posts only C sections.

**Notes:**
- *PR body stale.* Rewritten to match the head: `work_voice`, the current pins and the stricter rule. `declared_turning` and `an_undeclared_mask_is_none_never_a_guess` are gone from it. The issue comment on #1199 names the current pins.
- *Refusal does not name the script.* Done. `at_post` takes `script: Option<&str>`:
  - `posting_mounts.rs` (a setup's or the document's post, per mount) passes the name from `script_of`, e.g. `fanuc-lathe (built-in)` or the file path.
  - `posting_per_op.rs` does the same. Its resolver closure now returns `(Option<name>, text)`.
  - `posting.rs` `post_script` and an explicit script for all mounts have only the text, so they pass `None`, and the refusal says "the post script".
- *Stale comment in `setup_workholding::work_speed`.* The arm is unchanged. Its comment now says the door refuses every non-C section of an undeclared script on a lathe or mill-turn before the limit is judged at post, so the arm speaks there only where the limit is read outside a post. On a mill or with no machine, the stricter reading stands.
- *Matrix cell `("undeclared", Section::Tool)`.* `judged()` is now `("undeclared", _) => !chucked`. On lathe and mill-turn, both undeclared cells also assert the door's text (`no \`capabilities\` line`, `\`capabilities = 2;\``), so a door regression fails there by name.
- *Residual case.* Added to `docs/decisions/1199-undeclared-dialect.md`: on a mill or no-machine doc, an undeclared *lathe* script meets no door. Only the script's own meridian check stands, and #1265 does not cover it. The decision file also gets the cell-by-cell table, drops the sentence "Reading it as turning there only ever refuses (never changes a posted line)", and records the earlier "hold to the turning rules" reading as dropped.

**Pins:**
- `lathe_voice::tests::an_undeclared_script_is_held_to_the_door_on_a_machine_with_a_work_spindle`. With undeclared scripts (absent, `"2"`, `-1`, `0`, `4`) on a lathe and a mill-turn:
  - Face, off-centre Drill, Facing and on-centre Drill are refused by name (manifest, machine, both fixes).
  - Facing and on-centre Drill give the turning-post reason.
  - The C section passes.
  - The script is named when given.
  - Declared `1` and `2` behave as stated.
  - Mill and no-machine pass.
- `lathe_workholding_mill_post::every_machine_dialect_and_section_cell_gives_its_verdict`: covers the matrix cells and the door's text above.

**Gate** (macOS, debug, all green):
- Libs: camcraft-app lib 147, camcraft-post lib 38.
- App suites: `lathe_workholding_mill_post` 3, `lathe_work_spindle` 5, `lathe_workholding_kinds` 10 (+1 ignored), `lathe_workholding_live` 3, `posting` 17, `lathe_post_refusals` 11, `lathe_post` 7, `per_op_files` 9, `setup_mounts_post` 6, `conformance` 6, `golden_cl` 25.
- Every other suite that posts on a lathe or mill-turn, or reaches the door: `lathe_workholding_rpm` 6, `lathe_post_g76` 8, `drill_prior` 12, `lathe_cross_drill` 5, `c_axis_live` 5, `mcp_live` 10, `setup_post_options` 10, `post_not_judged` 4.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Effort: effort:high (issue #1199, P1). Planned to merge before PR #1265, which then merges main and resolves `posting.rs`, `posting_mounts.rs`, `posting_per_op.rs` (same script-label plumbing in both).
